paragraphs.text: The Ota are creatures currently depicted only in Lumithread Field . They are flying metallic humanoids without legs or wings.

Ota are led by praetors and were at war with dragons for the control of their world's suns. After the war with the Bastion of Suns, they obtained the power of lumithread, a coiled thread of pure energy utilized to feed and protect their outer plating.
